title: Rain fury grips Delhi-NCR: Waterlogging cripples commute amid IMD's red alert
content: Delhi and NCR experienced heavy rainfall on Friday morning. Waterlogging affected several areas, including Safdarjung Hospital and the airport. Traffic movement was significantly disrupted across the city and its surroundings. The India Meteorological Department recorded substantial rainfall amounts in various locations. Light rainfall is expected to continue over Delhi for the next two days.

title: Islamic Nato taking shape? What Saudi-Pak-Turkey Mecca pact means for Iran & Israel

The deal combines Saudi financial power, Turkish defence industry, and Pakistan's military strength. It comes amid regional tensions involving Iran, Israel, and the United States. This pact signals a shift towards regional security architecture development.

title: 'Get Harshit Rana and Rinku Singh': Ashwin names MI's ideal Hardik Pandya trade

The Mumbai Indians are considering rival team strengthening in trade discussions.

title: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan & Turkey sign 'Mecca' pact for mutual defence; India reacts

According to Pakistan's foreign ministry, the pact is "guided by the longstanding historical ties among the three states, based on the enduring bonds of brotherhood.

title: Michael Dell's son Zach Dell wants his Base Power batteries in every American backyard
content: Zach Dell's company Base Power is expanding its home battery business across America.  The company offers a unique membership model, replacing high upfront costs.  Base Power recently secured one billion dollars in new funding, valuing it at thirteen billion.  This expansion includes plans for international markets like the United Kingdom and Germany.  The firm is also increasing its battery manufacturing capacity to meet growing demand.

title: Watch: Locals use makeshift raft to ferry schoolkids through flooded Delhi streets
content: Heavy rain lashed Delhi, inundating low-lying areas and disrupting traffic significantly. Residents in Valmiki Basti waded through waist-deep water, facing decades of recurring flooding. The Municipal Corporation of Delhi received numerous complaints of tree fall and waterlogging across the city. Traffic slowed on major roads, and waterlogging affected key points like Mahipalpur T-Point. The India Meteorological Department issued a red alert, forecasting more rain.

title: Priscilla Chan founded a school in 2016; 10 yrs later, it closed after $125m funding
content: After ten years of service, The Primary School, co-founded by Priscilla Chan, will conclude its operations in June. This institution, known for offering tuition-free education and extensive family support, struggled to achieve state-average academic results despite receiving generous funding from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. The Initiative has decided to redirect its philanthropic priorities towards funding scientific research instead.

title: India's day out in Colombo: Gill sidelined by injury as bowlers find rhythm
content: India's bowlers gradually found their rhythm after a sluggish start as Manav Suthar, Ravindra Jadeja and Kuldeep Yadav picked up two wickets each to restrict SLC XI to 363 for 8 on the opening day of the warm-up match. Shubman Gill missed the day's play because of a finger injury, with KL Rahul leading the side.

title: 18-million-tonne section breaks away from Greenland glacier
content: In a striking display of nature, a massive section of a Greenland glacier detached and collapsed into the sea, captured by scientists on a research vessel. This occurrence unfolded as part of a study examining the implications of meltwater runoff on major ocean currents. Advanced autonomous robots are being utilized to collect vital data from the hazardous ice face.

title: Houston man’s solo trash cleanups grow into 100-volunteer movement
content: A Houston resident's initiative to clean up neglected areas has blossomed into a vibrant volunteer movement. With one hundred dedicated individuals now on board, their mission is to remove illegally dumped waste. Collaborating with local organizations and harnessing the power of social media, city officials and law enforcement are boosting efforts to tackle this pressing issue, ultimately enhancing the community's aesthetics and the well-being of its residents.

title: Elon Musk's preferred state halts data center approvals; says 'prove' this
content: Texas Governor Greg Abbott has ordered a temporary halt to new data center approvals.  Regulators must complete a comprehensive audit before projects can move forward.  Developers must prove electricity and water use, and tax incentives.  Abbott stated Texans must come first in all state decisions.  This move addresses growing scrutiny over rapid data center expansion.

title: US overtakes Gulf as India's biggest LPG supplier after Hormuz disruptions: Report
content: Supplies from Kuwait also fell sharply to 33,000 tonnes, down 43 per cent from June, while Qatar supplied just 19,000 tonnes. The contrast with the pre-conflict period has been striking. In January, the US exported only 268,000 tonnes of LPG to India, whereas the UAE supplied 826,000 tonnes. As a result, the US accounted for 73 per cent of India's LPG imports in July, compared with just 12 per cent in January.

title: 'Do not endorse anything said': MEA rejects Bangladesh's charge over Hasina event
content: Ministry of external affairs stated no government role in Sheikh Hasina's media event. The ministry does not endorse statements made at the private forum. Bangladesh expressed outrage over the interaction, calling it an affront to its sovereignty. Dhaka urged India to clarify its policy regarding conspiratorial activities. Both nations seek constructive relations based on mutual respect and equality.

title: Jantar Mantar 'terror plot' row: Amritsar top cop shunted; BJP cries foul
content: Amritsar Police Commissioner Gurpreet Singh Bhullar’s sudden removal has taken many by surprise. Harmanbir Singh Gill, who is currently the DIG of Border Range, has assumed the additional duty as CP. While the government cites administrative grounds for the change, rumors indicate that a controversial statement may have influenced this decision, leading to political debates about its timing.

title: Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce lawsuit takes major new turn in court
content: In a legal clash, 1587 Sneakers refutes claims made by Travis Kelce and Patrick Mahomes about their alleged control of the steakhouse. The sneaker company maintains that the NFL duo has been instrumental in promoting the establishment. This case hinges on the risk of consumer confusion with their branding strategy, as the steakhouse's name incorporates jersey numbers compared to the brand's historical meaning.

title: Jake Dennis on championship lead: 'Incredible fight with the five of us'
content: Andretti driver Jake Dennis now leads the Formula E world championship after securing a double podium at the Tokyo E-Prix. He recently opened up about leading the title race and expressed his excitement about competing at the upcoming London E-Prix next month. He is just two points ahead of Mitch Evans in the title race.

title: Luka Doncic's custody battle with Anamaria Goltes reportedly broke him emotionally
content: Luka Doncic and Anamaria Goltes are involved in a messy custody battle over the last two months and it might have broken him emotionally as he deals with it.

title: Allahabad HC grants parole to Atiq Ahmed's jailed sons for Abaan Ahmed's burial
content: The Allahabad High Court granted parole to Atiq Ahmed's jailed sons, Umar and Ali. They will attend the burial of their younger brother, Abaan Ahmed, who died in an accident. Abaan Ahmed was killed along with his friend Sonu in a road accident in Jhansi. Their bodies were brought to Prayagraj for the funeral service. The court order came after a petition filed by Atiq Ahmed's sister.

title: Jai Moondra: Rajasthan boy who found international cricket in Ireland
content: Jai Moondra left Tonk for higher studies in Ireland, believing cricket was behind him. But while chasing coding deadlines in Dublin, the dream stayed alive at Leinster Cricket Club. After impressing in his maiden T20I series against India and making his ODI debut, the fast bowler's remarkable journey traces back to Rajasthan, a Pakistani mentor in Dublin, an Indian coach in Jaipur, and years of quiet perseverance.

title: Patna erupts after fatal bus accident; mob torches vehicles, storms police post
content: Tragedy struck in Patna's Chhoti Pahadi when a pedestrian lost their life due to a bus collision on NH-30. The community erupted in fury, setting the bus and multiple police vehicles ablaze in retaliation. In the chaos, motorcycles were vandalized and a police post was attacked, leading to assaults on journalists capturing the unrest. Police had to step in to restore order amidst the turmoil.

title: 'He was my sponsor': How Virat Kohli helped CWG gold medallist Sakshi Chaudhary
content: Sakshi Chaudhary proudly claimed gold at the 2026 Commonwealth Games, attributing much of her success to the invaluable support from Virat Kohli's foundation. Making a strategic move to a lighter weight category turned out to be a winning decision. This endeavor led India to an impressive 2026 boxing tally of ten medals, including seven shining golds, marking a triumphant milestone for the nation's athletic representation.

title: 'Internal matter': MEA dismisses US lawmaker's criticism of FCRA Bill
content: Ministry of external affairs rejected criticism of its foreign funding law.  The ministry stated that legislative matters are internal decisions for Parliament.  Several countries, including the United States, also regulate foreign financing.  A US Congressman criticized proposed amendments to India's Foreign Contribution Regulation Act.  He warned these changes could affect India-US bilateral relations.

title: Dipa Karmakar's journey from flat feet to making history in gymnastics
content: Dipa Karmakar made history as India's first female gymnast to compete in the Olympics, overcoming significant challenges like flat feet and a lack of resources. She shined at the 2016 Rio Games with an impressive vault that garnered national acclaim. Following her success, she claimed gold at an international event and received many prestigious accolades. Despite facing injuries, Karmakar showed remarkable resilience, returning to gymnastics time and again.

title: 'Feared social stigma': Delhi man drowns pregnant teen daughter in Chambal
content: In a tragic turn of events, a pregnant teenager was reportedly drowned in the Chambal river by her own father and brother-in-law. The young girl, who was four months pregnant, was allegedly coerced into jumping into the river. When she resisted, they overpowered her, leading to her death. The father admitted to the crime, driven by the fear of societal judgment, while the brother-in-law has also been taken into custody.

title: 'Avoid Lutyens web': PM Modi's advice to 45 NDA MPs at breakfast meet
content: In the meeting, which also included the rebel factions from the Uddhav Sena and Mamata Banerjee's TMC, PM Modi said: "No one should say anything trashy on TV. Maintain full dignity at all times. Engage actively in social media through Facebook, Instagram and X; interact with youth, inform government welfare work, encourage youth for sports activities." Modi advised the MPs to follow the party line and calmly present their views on every issue.

title: Scientists discover Titan's methane rainstorms are more intense than expected
content: On the distant moon Titan, intense methane rainstorms transform the icy terrain, creating striking alluvial fans that showcase the areas most affected by these rare deluges. Scientists leverage data from the Cassini mission to create models of these phenomena, which happen less frequently than once every Titan year—a period nearly equivalent to 30 Earth years. Understanding Titan's unique weather patterns offers insights into extreme rainfall events here on our planet.

title: Why stock market's close is now an auction - explained
content: For over three decades, the closing price was the volume-weighted average (VWAP) of all trades between 3:00 pm and 3:30 pm. Nobody actually traded at that price. It was a calculation, not a transaction. For long-term investors, nothing changes. For index funds and traders, the closing routine is now different.

title: Beyond BrahMos: India builds next generation of cheap precision weapons
content: Modern conflicts necessitate deep stocks of precision weapons, driving demand for affordable solutions. India is developing advanced glide bombs, including powered versions of the SAAW weapon. These weapons will allow strikes deep inside hostile territory without significant risk. Private industry and government organizations are contributing to this capability development. This strategic investment ensures India's air force maintains effective and survivable strike options.

title: NTA's own experts leaked NEET-UG papers for cash, CBI chargesheet alleges
content: The CBI has filed a chargesheet naming thirteen individuals in a paper leak conspiracy.  NTA subject experts allegedly accessed and shared confidential examination questions illegally.  A chain of intermediaries then distributed these leaked papers to candidates for money.  Digital evidence confirms the circulation of leaked questions through messaging platforms.  The investigation uncovered a structured supply chain involving coaching operators and brokers.

title: Kolkata real estate: 60% of stalled projects may get clearance within days
content: Kolkata's real estate sector may see a revival soon, as over half of the stalled projects are likely to receive clearance. With approvals anticipated before mid-August, this comes after a thorough review triggered by a warehouse collapse. The government's proactive stance will not only rejuvenate construction activities but also provide a much-needed boost to the workforce in the industry.

title: Younger, wider, diverse: How India's investor base is changing
content: India's investor community is witnessing remarkable transformation, with a younger demographic leading the growth. The median age of investors has notably declined, indicating an influx of fresh talent. Additionally, participation is extending beyond major metropolitan areas, while the growing number of female investors enhances gender diversity. This evolving landscape highlights a vibrant and inclusive financial market across the nation.

title: Ink thrown at AISA president Neha Bora during Jharkhand students' protest
content: In Ranchi, during a tense protest, Neha Bora, AISA president, became the target of an ink attack as she voiced support for job aspirants demanding redress for suspected misconduct in competitive exams. She highlighted the necessity for transparency and accountability within governmental exam procedures and called for the expulsion of private agencies marred by corruption allegations. Protesters rallied for the annulment of multiple exams and a thorough CBI inquiry.

title: Mithun Chakraborty hospitalised for minor surgery in Kolkata

This was revealed by West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari via social media. After visiting the actor, Adhikari reported that Mithun is in stable condition and is expected to be discharged shortly after undergoing the operation on Thursday night.

title: 'Jana Nayagan' box office collection: Vijay and Pooja Hegde starrer slows down

With dwindling daily earnings and minimal theater attendance, the film's progress seems sluggish. Nonetheless, it has still managed to boost its overall collection, with the total India net amount now standing at an impressive 185.26 crore rupees, despite a slow third week.

Police identified the man using video and CCTV footage from railway stations.  This incident follows two previous murders on local trains over trivial disputes.  Authorities are confident of an imminent arrest in this disturbing case.
